name: Steam ROM Manager
description: The Electron main process configures electron-updater, disables automatic download, checks for updates after the window is ready, and only downloads/installs through explicit IPC actions. This supports a primary updater using the framework channel and manifest hash behavior recorded for the app, while the source does not establish a pinned signing key.
limitations: electron-updater framework internals and released artifact signing are not contained in this checkout.
Snapshot is a newly retrieved default branch, not the historical study revision.
